title: Rare Steak with Ketogem Sauce
description: A low-carb, high-fat dish featuring a rare steak served with a creamy ketogem sauce.
instructions: Bring the steak to room temperature.
Season the steak with salt and pepper.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the steak for 1-2 minutes per side.
Finish cooking the steak in the oven at 300°F (150°C) for 10-15 minutes.
Let the steak rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Meanwhile, melt the butter in a saucepan over low heat.
Add the ketogem to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Simmer the ketogem sauce for 2-3 minutes.
Serve the rare steak with the ketogem sauce.
Optional: serve with a side of sautéed vegetables.
